notes.title: Enemy Overview – The Mob
notes.content:
Catapultists!
Welcome to a brand new Enemy Overview article. Who’s trying to attack our castle this time?

It’s...the Mob!

[previewyoutube=EnqJQEgIRZo;full][/previewyoutube]
Don’t let hilarious looks fool you. Behind the facade of silliness, the Mob Enemy is really...well, actually they are still ridiculously silly, but they are very, very weak and cowardly. The weakest enemy in the game in fact. 

If you want to practice your aim, they are the perfect targets. Sometimes, they don't even run away from incoming projectiles. They will just cower in fear awaiting the final crash of a flying car. On the other hand, who wouldn’t? But at least they have each other. You'll never see a Mob enemy without the rest of his gang around. Pillage together, crushed by crazy combos together.

Now let's have a serious discussion: “The Mob—are they lvl 1 crooks or lvl 100 bosses?” 
Share your thoughts in the comments below and join the Discussion on Steam and Discord.

Enemy Overview series
Do you enjoy the series? Check out the previous article:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1104200/announcements/detail/2879452759163448294
Keep your eyes open for more articles from the Enemy Overview series coming up soon™!

notes.title: A Ridiculous Story of Throwing Stuff
notes.content:
Catapultists!
Sometimes you have to throw away a lot of ideas to land the one you like. For our in-game catapult, it was around 30—watch the video to check out some of them.

[previewyoutube=vFi_BeDWNJE;full][/previewyoutube]

We considered Leonardo da Vinci's catapult,  the rotating hammer, and many others, but they weren’t enough. We wanted a design screaming “use me to throw something!”. Finally it hit us—hands. What’s better for throwing things than a hand? 

Normally, you’d be limited by weight and environment. Ok, maybe you can pick up a car, but where to throw it? (Unless you really, really want to be fined for vandalism.) There are no such limits in Ridiculous Catapult Simulator. Your hand becomes a catapult and the castle defence is in your hands! Literally.

What do you think about the concept? Let us know in the comments below and join the Discussion on Steam and Discord.

Now that we deliberately got you in the mood for hitting things, why don’t you hit that “Add to wishlist” button? Give it a shot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104200/Ridiculous_Catapult_Simulator/

notes.title: Enemy Overview - Slime
notes.content:
Catapultists!
The number one rule of ballistic combat is to know your enemy. In this new series of Enemy Overview articles, we will present you the basic characteristics of other-worldly creatures that try to invade our castle.

First, let’s meet Slime.

[previewyoutube=5MUAXF_NGrQ;full][/previewyoutube]
It may look like a matryoshka doll, it may replicate like a matryoshka doll, but you definitely don’t want to put it on your cupboard. 

Slimes’ defense mechanism makes them duplicate when their Health Points drop below a certain threshold. More and more slimes will spawn from a single one so you have to react quickly or deal AoE (Area of Effect) damage to stop them from spreading.

Enemy Overview series
What do you think of the Slime? Easy peasy or a hard egg to crack? Let us know in the comments below and join the Discussion on Steam and Discord.

Keep your eyes open for more articles from the Enemy Overview series coming up soon™!

notes.title: ‘Wackiest Ammo’ contest winners!
notes.content:
Catapulists!

Yesterday we finished our first contest, where the task was to come up with the most ridiculous thing that could be launched from a catapult.

We have decided that the most ridiculous things are:

More catapults! Like the Russian dolls but with catapults
 Chainsaws
 LEGO aka Pain Bricks
 A jar of mayonnaise
 Trojan horse


We would like to thank everyone who participated and wish them better luck next time!

We will contact the winners via private message on Discord. 
(Because we have Discord! 
And we hang out there and talk. 
And maybe you'd come by, too? 
Anyway we can’t wait to meet you!)

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35228709/23b4bf8d23cca92f417c2d1ff073b56efb99a252.jpg

The hour you’ve all been waiting for is here! For the first time ever, Ridiculous Catapult Simulator, a 3D tower defense with rag-doll physics and deck-building elements, has gotten a demo and you can play it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1418930/

Ridiculous Catapult Simulator’s demo is available as part of the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition and will be accessible until the end of the event, October 13.

In the demo, you’ll defend your castle against 5 waves of enemies with up to 20 different types of absurd ammo to add to your ammo deck and 11 upgrades to choose from throughout your campaign. All of these options will allow you to strategize the best possible counter offensive—but you can also just have fun launching random ammo to see what makes the biggest BOOM!

Feedback
After playing the demo, share your impressions with us on Discord or in Steam Discussions. We appreciate all of your feedback, as it helps us to make the best possible game. We can’t wait to hear from you!

Play the demo today! Bombs—I mean, bathtubs away!!!
